footer.tagline: The open-source online booking platform for clinics, salons and any appointment-driven business — with the Jalali calendar, SMS reminders and real-time reservations.
footer.rights: Nobat — online appointment booking · Released under the MIT license

landing.heroSubtitle: Nobat makes online appointment booking effortless for clinics, salons and any appointment-driven business: customers pick their own day and time, staff manage their shifts, and SMS reminders go out automatically.

previewRows.2: Cancel in one click — the slot frees up instantly

landing.previewNote: Right now — without a single phone call
landing.featuresSubtitle: From the public booking page to the management dashboard — fully bilingual, RTL-native and Jalali-ready from day one.

0.title: Multi-business
0.description: Every business gets its own world: services, staff, working hours and a dedicated booking page at its own address.

1.title: Real-time booking
1.description: Available slots are computed live from real staff shifts — two customers can never fight over the same slot.

2.title: Staff & shift management
2.description: Define each teammate's working hours separately and manage shift changes without phone calls and spreadsheets.

3.title: SMS reminders
3.description: The Kavenegar driver sits behind a simple SMS contract — need another provider? Just write a new driver.

4.title: Management dashboard
4.description: Every booking's status, today's appointments and the daily workflow at a glance; status changes apply with one click.

5.title: Bilingual & Jalali
5.description: A fully RTL Persian interface with the Vazirmatn font, plus a polished English experience — switch anytime from the navbar.

landing.stepsSubtitle: From picking a business to your tracking code in under a minute.

0.title: Pick a business
0.description: Open the clinic or salon you like from the list of active businesses and browse its services.

1.title: Choose a service and a time
1.description: Only genuinely free slots are shown; you choose the day, the time and the staff member.

2.title: Get confirmed, get reminded
2.description: A tracking code is issued instantly and an SMS reminder arrives before your appointment.

landing.dirSubtitle: Pick one and book your slot right away.
